title: Jagged Charred Italian Polenta Pilaf
description: A charred and gooey Italian dish featuring ras el hanout, infused oil, and polenta, served on a hot stone plate. This Venetian-inspired recipe is nut-free and perfect for a unique dinner experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the polenta, ras el hanout, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add in the infused oil, stirring until the mixture is well combined.
Spread the polenta mixture onto a hot stone plate, forming a jagged and uneven shape.
Top the polenta with the halved cherry tomatoes and thinly sliced red onion.
Sprinkle the crumbly grana padano cheese over the top of the polenta and vegetables.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the cheese and vegetables.
Bake the polenta pilaf in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is charred and the polenta is cooked through.
Remove the pilaf from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the jagged charred Italian polenta pilaf immediately, straight from the hot stone plate.
